text:
H.R. 6500 | Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act, 2027 | Rep. Jason Smith (R-MO) | Ways and Means Committee

📅 2 September 2026 | 📌 Presented to President
What's next: President has 10 days (Sundays excepted): sign, veto, or it becomes law unsigned (pocket veto if adjournment prevents return)

Summary: The bill would extend through the end of 2028 duty-free trade benefits that allow most exports from eligible sub-Saharan African countries to enter the U.S. market without tariffs, while also extending customs user fees through the end of 2031. It would also allow for refunds of duties paid on African imports that entered the country after September 30, 2025.

S. 858 | Hershel ‘Woody' Williams National Medal of Honor Monument Location Act | Sen. James Justice (R-WV) | Energy and Natural Resources Committee

📅 2 September 2026 | 📌 Presented to President
What's next: President has 10 days (Sundays excepted): sign, veto, or it becomes law unsigned (pocket veto if adjournment prevents return)

Summary: The bill would authorize the National Medal of Honor Museum Foundation to build a commemorative monument on the National Mall honoring Medal of Honor recipients for their acts of valor and sacrifice. The monument would be required to be located within the central area of the National Mall, between the Capitol and Lincoln Memorial.
